# Controlled experiment: move UP one step, then fire, then inspect arch top-bar row vs player row.
action(['UP'])
r1=last_action_result
print("after UP: player bbox", end=" ")
def bbox(fr,color):
    best=None
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']==color:
            b=n['boundary']
            r0=min(p[0] for p in b);r1=max(p[0] for p in b)
            c0=min(p[1] for p in b);c1=max(p[1] for p in b)
            if best is None or n['pixels']>best[4]: best=(r0,r1,c0,c1,n['pixels'])
    return best
print(bbox(current_frame,'b'), "result", r1.get('board_changed'), r1.get('game_over'))

action(['SPACE'])
r2=last_action_result
print("after SPACE: game_over",r2.get('game_over'),"level_completed",r2.get('level_completed'),"done",r2.get('done'))

# Find peak magenta frame and per-row magenta counts
fs=frame_sequence
best_i=0;best_px=0
for i in range(fs.count):
    fr=fs.at(i)
    px=sum(n['pixels'] for n in fr.segmentation['nodes'] if n['color']=='M')
    if px>best_px: best_px=px;best_i=i
peak=fs.at(best_i)
print("peak frame",best_i,"magenta px",best_px)
# per-row magenta counts
from collections import defaultdict
rows=defaultdict(int)
for n in peak.segmentation['nodes']:
    if n['color']=='M':
        for (r,c) in n['pixels'] if isinstance(n['pixels'],list) else []:
            pass
# pixels is a count, not list. Re-derive rows from boundary is insufficient; use ascii small region instead.
# Use ascii to read magenta rows in the arch region cols 10-50
a=peak.ascii.split('\n')
print("player bbox in peak:", bbox(peak,'b'))
print("magenta row extents (rows with M in cols 10-50):")
for r in range(0,64):
    line=a[r]
    seg=line[10:50]
    if 'M' in seg:
        cnt=seg.count('M')
        print(r, cnt)
